definitions: A feature in video editing software, such as Adobe After Effects, that allows users to quickly select and separate a foreground element from its background in a video sequence.
A tool used for rotoscoping, which is the process of creating a matte or mask around an object in a video frame by frame.
examples: The Roto Brush Tool made quick work of isolating the dancer.
I used the Roto Brush Tool to remove the background from the footage.
Mastering the Roto Brush Tool can save hours in post-production.
